notes.title: Speed update
notes.content:
What's new ?

[b]4 archives are now available.[/b] 

You can access them after finishing the game once in the library. Finishing all the mini-games will award you with an achievement.

[b]New speed achievement : finish the game in less than 17 minutes[/b] 
[list]
    [*]it is possible without glitches !
    [*]several minor level tweaks added to facilitate the run
    [*]one new major secret. With it you can bypass almost completely the 2 levels with the most randoms elements !
    [*]seconds are now shown on the end screen
    [*]achievement will not unlock in puzzle game mode
[/list] 

Additionaly, I corrected a minor regression from last patch in ocean level, a sound issue, and a bug with pause menu.

Unfortunately I don't have as much time as before to put into the game, still I hope you will enjoy this patch.

I am currently working tons of hours on my current project "Cool Headed".
You can check it out on gamejolt.

For new players trying the game, don't let this patch mislead you : "A dead world's dream" is a challenging platformer, but if you rush and don't pay attention to the riddles you will miss out a lot.
A smart and cautious player can finish the game with beginner skill in platformers.

Have fun and kind regards

notes.title: Puzzle update
notes.content:
Hi there !

I am happy to announce the release of the [b]Puzzle update[/b].

This update is mostly aimed toward players who are looking for a challenge after completing the game, but are not interested in the unfair "Hard" mode.
Content is unlocked after finishing the game once.

[b]What's new ?[/b]

[list]
    [*]The archives : 2 mini-challenges accessible from library's bookcases
There are only 2 for now, but I will expand it from time to time until there are 8. Those mini-challenges give a little bit of insight on the hermit's plan.
    [*]Puzzle game mode : a new game mode with a twist and an achievement to earn.
    [*]And of course bug fixes, thank to all of you who brought bugs to my attention.
[/list]

[b]What is puzzle mode?[/b]

Puzzle mode is an alternate universe where the hermit plan has gone a little wrong : the main portal can only reach 4 places, all other portals forever out of reach.

To complete this challenge, you will have to find everything you can every step of the way.

A surprise awaits you in shroom grotto, that is, if you can reach it !

[b]What's next ?[/b].

I will let this version of the game rest for a while, fixing bugs if necessary.
From time to time, I will add archives, and work on a big content update centered around a new game mode: "The world tree".

I hope you will enjoy the new content, have fun !

notes.title: Performance update live
notes.content:
[b]Performance update is now live as of 2016-09-30.[/b] 

Improvements were a lot easier to implement than I originally thought:
[list]
    [*]hub area improved
    [*]factory area improved
[/list] 
Other changes in this version include:
[list]
    [*]a pointer to the registry at the beginning of the game (if you got less than 5 species)
    [*]an additionnal hint in shroom level to find energy booster. No more excuses not finding it !
    [*]more contrast to branches in jungle
    [*]a little addition to help come back from the end of toxic swamp, as well as some minor changes.
    [*]spelling error corrected in a dialog
    [*]a critter to help understand green/red light concept in ocean base
    [*]other very minor changes
[/list] 
Currently in experimental:
[list] 
[*]In game clock in pause menu
[/list] 
I will now stop the update frenzy, correcting bugs of course if necessary. Unless something major comes up, don't expect an update before november.
Ideally, I would like to add something interesting for the next release (an achievement forcing to do the game a certain way? challenges specific to some levels?). 
Tell me what you think !

I believe "A dead world's dream" has gotten much more accessible than it was at release, you should try it if you had previous trouble with controls or performance.

notes.title: Performance update
notes.content:
As of 2016-09-28, updated gameplay release is now live. 
Please let me know if you notice any bugs.

If you encounter a performance issue, you should consider participating in the experimental testing : Hub area should have been improved hopefuly.
I will now work on Energy Factory performance issues, but it will take more time and the result won't be as noticeable.

Other important change will be the addition of a way to keep track of the ingame clock. It has not been decided yet how it will be added, I am leaning on option 2 :
-option 1 in a menu
-option 2 in a location with a physical clock
-option 3 with the press of a button


EDIT1: I settled for a clock in pause menu (option 1) Improvements to main area and factory are at a satisfactory level
